rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: forms (a), (b), and (c) — the evaluated system follows a code-held Analyzer → Formalizer → Soufflé Verifier pipeline; code dispatches LLMs for bounded analysis and predicate-generation tasks, iterates formalization under a fixed maximum of five calls, and then runs the deterministic verifier. The verifier's result can reject or overturn the analyzer's equivalence judgment without a model choosing whether to honor it.
